requirements.title: Deterministic mini-Vrooli tarball
requirements.description: Given a manifest, produce a tarball that includes required scenarios/resources (from analyzer), always includes packages/, always includes vrooli-autoheal, excludes unrelated content, and embeds a generated trimmed go.work so stripped modules aren’t referenced.

validation.notes: Bundle include/exclude rules + deterministic archive writer.
API endpoint builds a tarball artifact from a manifest.

requirements.title: Tarball is reproducible and self-contained
requirements.description: The produced tarball can be scp’d to a fresh VPS and unpacked without missing files (packages/, required scenarios/resources present, no references back to the original repo path).

validation.notes: Asserts deterministic bytes and relative tar entry names.
